notes.title: Who is John Mambo?
notes.notes:
Shots, explosions and a large number of weapons with which to defeat your enemies await you

The game consists of 6 levels of continuous action, where you will not be able to get lost for a single second, since you will have to face an entire army that will not hesitate to make you blow up.

John Mambo has decided to enlist in the most suicidal missions and this time it will be your turn to pacify a lost area of the Pacific.

All the components of the project have been lovers of videogames and arcades since our childhood, when we spent hours in arcades and with our 8-bit computers.

We hope you enjoy our demo very much!
